tagline: Brazilian market data for your AI agent
brief: An open source MCP server that gives AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Codex) data on Brazilian assets through one read-only SQL tool over a local DuckDB cache: connected, precise and trustworthy.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, and distinct from the usual rising-arrow and bar-chart marks of finance.

concepts.name: Data hub
concepts.idea: A core with bars of different lengths radiating from it: many data sources, one place to read them.
rationale: The hub is the one SQL tool; the bars are prices, filings and macro series of different sizes
Green is the colour of money without the usual arrow or coin
Reads at 16 px with six heavier bars and works in one colour
